**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4.4 "Audit Rights" (p0059) is the only verification right binding Corio; searches for audit/inspection/records/systems-access across the Fees section, Exhibit B pricing and revenue-sharing terms, Payment Terms, Shared Resources and Miscellaneous turned up no other audit or access mechanic.
- **Already at/above fallback:** once each calendar year, independent CPA reasonably acceptable to Corio, Commerce One bears inspection costs, records-only inspection with no systems access.
- **Fails fallback:** notice is only "reasonable notice" (no fixed minimum), and cost-shifting bites at underpayment >5% rather than the 10% fallback threshold.
- **Cure (2 surgical replaces in p0059, validated ok:true):** "upon at least fifteen (15) days' notice" and "more than ten percent (10%)"; all other wording preserved verbatim, and preferred-only extras (30 days, express business-hours/confidentiality/off-site wording) were noted in the rationale rather than added.
